summary:
Status: PROPOSED. The OR-first orchestration design's status line reads 'Proposed architecture; records direction and implementation preparation, not production authorization'. Since 2026-09-07 (section 1.2) its harness is optional and conditional, and H0-H8 are not the routine roadmap. The development design inventory lists it as Proposed and conditional. No ADR adopts it; ADR-0081 is the only accepted record in this family.

Proposed planners: WorkSizer (DSM partitioning), SddPlanner (value of information and bounded optimal stopping), PortfolioScheduler (robust multi-mode RCPSP), CiPlanner (closure, set cover, bin packing, parallel-machine scheduling), ReviewPlanner (bipartite matching, min-cost flow), AgentAllocator (generalized assignment, contract net) and RecoveryPlanner (shortest path or stochastic planning over saga states), with a snapshot, receipt and determinism envelope. OR-first means explicit decisions and constraints, not a solver prerequisite; CP-SAT is qualified only for a measured bottleneck. No repository depends on a solver.

Implemented: only the bounded greedy ordinary-assignment kernel (coordination/ordinary-assignment-kernel), whose roadmap prose calls the design 'accepted'; that wording is the outlier. Generic techniques behind each planner are ADR-0098 tranche 2 (OR3, OR4, OR15, OR16, OR18-OR22). ADR-0098 §11 tranche 2 (FS-GG/.github#5245) lists this record; the generic technique is a pack entry, the FS-GG instance stays here (§10).
title: OR-first orchestration planner stack: Proposed, optional, partly implemented by LEARN-01
